name: quickcart
description: QuickCart - Enterprise 10-Minute Hyperlocal Fullstack Quick-Commerce Delivery Application

scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && cd backend && (mvnw package -DskipTests || mvn package -DskipTests)
scripts.test:rust: cd services/flash-sale-engine && (cargo test || echo "Rust toolchain optional locally")
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix frontend run test && cd backend && (mvnw -B test -Dspring.profiles.active=test || mvn -B test -Dspring.profiles.active=test) && cd services/ai-demand-engine && (python -m pytest || pytest) && cd services/telemetry-service && go test -v ./...
scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
